subject: Partnership opportunity: Zion Tech Group — AI/IT services and free tools
body:
Hi,

Thanks for the conversation so far. I’d like to propose a simple next step that benefits both teams.

We can move forward in two complementary ways:

  • Co-sale or referral on AI/IT managed services with clear margin sharing
  • Pilot one low-risk, high-value automation or observability project with measurable outcomes

Our new AI services are built for real operations, not demos. We also offer free tools and assessments at https://ziontechgroup.com so you can evaluate value before scaling.

If helpful, I’m available for a short call: https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup

Best,
Kleber Garcia Alcatrao
CEO — Zion Tech Group
llm_instruction: Rewrite in the client’s language, keep the partnership pilot and Calendly/ziontechgroup.com CTAs, keep tone friendly professional CEO-level.
